notes.title: Version 0.21.4.0 updates content
notes.notes:
Modification:
. Decrease Monsters' HP, to make easier in early game
. Increase the drop probability of weapon
. Increase the damage of hammer and sword
. Players can play infinite game mode after pass normal game mode
. Delete the ranking by passed level of normal game mode

notes.title: Version 0.21.1.0 updates main content
notes.notes:
Modification:
. Infinite Game Mode update: Now, not only level random, monster also will totally random in level.
. Player can see have passed how many levels in Infinite Game Mode.
. Slight decrease the second hit damage of staff.

Fixed:
. After switch or update equipment, the status up from level up and statue will be clear.
. Thief +50% critical damage not work.
. Boss Goblin Witch can get damaged unexpected.
. Variant Meat description mistake.
. Kill boss President in Infinite Game Mode may cause game error.
. Cards - Adventure may cause room can pass sometimes.

notes.title: Infinite Game Mode Added! Version 0.20.0.2 updates main content
notes.notes:
| New Content
. Add new game mode——Infinite Game Mode:
After passing the final Boss, player will unlock Infinite Game Mode. Levels will be random and monsters will get stronger by passed level number, and also the player. Infinite game mode will test player's ability of extremity. 
. Add a new ranking: Infinite Game Mode passed levels ranking
. Add a new game map——Volcano scene, only in infinite game mode


| Balance
. Make Succubus's attack speed faster.

| Fix
. White blood cell plays wrong animation when be repeled and attacking at the same time.
. Fix a few other bug.

notes.title: Version 0.11.8.1 updates main content
notes.notes:
. According some feedbacks, add a new operation mode, player can move by keyboard, attack by mouse.
. Optimize some Monsters' AI, like Shield Goblin.
. Optimize positions of some monster at a few levels

notes.title: Version 0.11.7.1 updates main content
notes.notes:
Fix:
Skill problems of some weapons.
Goblin Army Commander may roll out the scene accidentally.
In Stage 3, no response of interacting the skeleton cemetery.
Fix some weapon configs may cause some treasure chests not drop items.
Modify gamepad L1 or R1 causes UI problem.

Balance:
Modify the Goblin whisperer's AI and animation.
Reduce the amount of bonus by talent.
Adjust the position and amount of monsters of some levels.
